comment: Haven of the Spirit Dragon '{2},{T}, Sacrifice: return target Dragon creature card from your graveyard to your hand'. WHICH card comes back is a searched decision (one plan variant per distinct legal graveyard name), so BOTH graveyard Dragons must validate -- a fixture asserting only one would still pass if the enumeration collapsed to a first-match. The two illegal siblings pin the target filter: a non-creature in the graveyard, and a Dragon that is not in the graveyard at all. The graveyard cannot be reached by seed-driven goldfish play here (nothing can kill our creatures, so it fills only by cleanup discard), which is why this is a constructed board.
